# Contradiction Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ContradictionKind`](gmeow-ContradictionKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ContradictionKind>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An open value vocabulary of contradiction flavours.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ContradictionKind`](gmeow-ContradictionKind.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the contradiction-flavour axis — the kinds (factual, temporal, numeric, framing, …) that [`gmeow:contradictionKind`](../properties/gmeow-contradictionKind.md) draws from; mint a fresh individual for a flavour not seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a contradiction-kind SUBCLASS of [`gmeow:Contradiction`](gmeow-Contradiction.md) (the kind is a value, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid confusing it with [`gmeow:SupportPolarity`](gmeow-SupportPolarity.md) — kind is the flavour of the conflict, polarity is a span's stance toward a claim.

### How to use

- Add a new flavour as a [`gmeow:ContradictionKind`](gmeow-ContradictionKind.md) individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition); reference it from a [`gmeow:Contradiction`](gmeow-Contradiction.md) via [`gmeow:contradictionKind`](../properties/gmeow-contradictionKind.md).

### Examples

- ex:contradictionKindFactual a [`gmeow:ContradictionKind`](gmeow-ContradictionKind.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "factual"@en.
